data.highlights:
The Sand Bar Shelling Tour with Florida Island Tours offers a relaxed, family-friendly way to explore Marco Island’s shallow Gulf waters and uncover natural treasures at water-level. This guided boat tour focuses on remote sand bars that emerge with the tide, creating ideal conditions for shelling, wildlife spotting, and easy wading for all ages. Because these areas shift daily, each outing feels unique, shaped by tides, wind, and recent shell activity.

During the tour, guests step off the boat onto firm, shallow sand where shells naturally collect. Captains share simple shell-spotting tips and local insight while keeping the experience unhurried and enjoyable. Dolphins often cruise nearby, shorebirds forage along the edges, and kids love the freedom to explore without waves or crowds. The calm setting also makes this tour a favorite for grandparents, first-time shellers, and families with younger children.

Designed to balance discovery with comfort, the Sand Bar Shelling Tour delivers an authentic Marco Island experience rooted in nature, curiosity, and time together on the water. 🐚🌊

- Partial refund if the tour ends early for weather or safety reasons.

- Any canceled tours can be subject to a fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
